page.layout: One scanned page: the outer side of a limp vellum binding (cover, not a printed leaf). No printed text block, no margins with text. Blind-tooled frame lines and stains only.
page.notes: Image shows a bound book cover of pale vellum with five raised sewing bands on the spine edge, blind-tooled border rules and a small tool impression near the lower centre. No printed words are visible. Stains, wear and a crack at the top and bottom of the spine edge are not text and are not transcribed.
